slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total amount of money available at the end of the three-year horizon?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is final wealth, i.e. total money available at the end of year 3, and the user confirmed it. This resolves whether 'earnings' means final wealth rather than net profit or another measure.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1, is P2 and was clarified before READY_TO_MODEL. No unresolved P0 or P1 hidden slots remained when the agent stopped.

summary: The agent clarified the objective definition relevant to the only hidden slot and then stopped. Remaining modeling assumptions were outside the listed hidden slots, so the interaction is adequate for hidden-slot recovery.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
